content.title: Italy's Nexi says it received TPG offer for digital banking assets
content.summary: MILAN (Reuters) -Italy's Nexi  has received an offer from ​U.S. private equity fund TPG for ‌several assets in its digital banking solutions business, the ‌payments group said on Friday.  The board will look at the offer, Nexi said in a statement, reacting to a report by Bloomberg about the TPG ⁠approach.  Shares in ‌Milan-listed Nexi rose as much 5% to 5.31 euros on ‍Friday following the report, which said the offer, valid until mid-December, was worth 1 billion euros ​and targeted the digital banking solutions unit.

content.title: Exclusive-Financial software provider OneStream explores sale after share price drop, sources say
content.summary: (Reuters) -Financial software maker OneStream is exploring strategic options including a possible sale, less than 18 months after its ​stock market debut, according to three people familiar with the matter.  OneStream has been working with investment ‌bankers at JPMorgan Chase on its options, the sources said, noting that deliberations are at an early stage and there is no ‌guarantee of any transaction involving the company.  Private equity firms including Blackstone and Hg are among the names that the sources said have been studying possible bids for OneStream in recent weeks.

content.title: TPG (TPG) Earnings Surge 997% Challenges Cautious Market Narratives on Growth Prospects
content.summary: TPG (TPG) posted a remarkable turnaround in its latest earnings report, with profits surging by 997.3% over the past year after years of average annual declines of 81.6%. Net profit margins also increased to 2.3%, compared to just 0.3% in the year-ago period. Looking ahead, while annual earnings are projected to grow at a brisk 55% rate, revenue is forecast to decline by 13.4% per year through the next three years.
